newsitem.title: USA: Illinois says no start set for Clinton nuke.
newsitem.headline: Illinois says no start set for Clinton nuke.

text.p: Illinois Power Co has not set a startup date for its 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power plant in Clinton, Ill., despite earlier expectations the plant could resume operations in the second week of this month, a company spokesman said.
"We have not set a restart date," spokesman John Dewey said Tuesday, adding "there won't be a startup this week."
The company had said the plant could resume operations near Sept 11, then postponed the expected restart to near September 14 before declining to set any date for expected resumption of operations.

The plant was shut Sept 6 for repairs to a recirculation pump seal. Illinois Power said restart of the unit then had to be pushed back while an evaluation of repairs was submitted to the federal Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
Illnois Power is a subsidiary of Illinova Corp.
